summary.motive: Create impossible natural pick/rub traffic for underneath zone and man defenders while stretching the defense horizontally and vertically with perimeter rail and deep clearout routes.
summary.keyDefender: Mike Linebacker & Nickel DB (Underneath Hook/Curl defenders)
summary.whyItWorks: By crossing H and Y at 5-6 yards depth within arm's reach, underneath defenders cannot switch or track across the formation without colliding, freeing H for an easy catch in stride with massive YAC potential.
summary.failureMode: Underneath defenders passing off the crossers cleanly with banjo calls, or interior defensive tackle quick pressure collapsing the pocket before the mesh crosses.

beats.title: Pre-Snap Trips Right Alignment & MOFO Shell
beats.text: Andy Reid aligns in 11 Personnel Gun Trips Right. The defense shows a two-high Middle of Field Open (MOFO) shell, creating space for underneath horizontal crossers.

beats.title: The Mesh Release & Initial Route Stems
beats.text: H and Y release on crossing paths at 5 and 6 yards depth, aiming for an arm-to-arm high-five rub. RB releases on a rapid rail route to widen the boundary Will linebacker.

beats.title: Underneath Rub Conflict on Mike & Nickel
beats.text: As H crosses underneath Y, the Nickel defender is impeded by the crossing body. The Mike is frozen in space, unable to pass off or mirror H through the collision traffic.

beats.title: Mesh Separation & RB Rail Isolation
beats.text: H clears the rub with clear green grass in the boundary flat. With the Will linebacker pulled wide by the RB rail route, the underneath throwing lane is completely open.

beats.title: Open Crosser Catch & Run-After-Catch (YAC)
beats.text: The QB delivers a strike in stride to H at the boundary hash, allowing Travis Kelce to turn upfield into open space for an explosive chunk gain.

relations.tell: Base mesh timing with RB releasing on a wide rail route while slot receivers execute underneath shallow cross rub.
